title: Editor E1, binding layer: every page App declares the template and slot it sits in by default
detail: All 146 page Apps carried an empty surfaces.page descriptor. lib/apps/catalog.ts now derives defaultTemplate and defaultSlot for each: the slot the coded route default (defaultLayoutFor) places the block in, else the engine's own fallback for an unplaced module (the Single template's first slot). Nothing was invented: the values restate what the renderer already does. unboundPageDescriptors in scripts/surface-binding-baseline.json drops 146 to 0, which closes PROG-E1.

verify.note: Fails while any page App has an empty surface descriptor.
